style_paragraph.text: Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI. Plush character materials with subsurface scattering; soft fur with individual strands catching the light; glossy eyes with bright catchlights; translucent wing membranes where light passes through. Warm amber key light with cool blue fill and a soft rim light; teal-orange cinematic grade. Shallow depth of field with soft bokeh, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle film grain. Appealing exaggerated proportions, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features. Emotionally warm atmosphere.
